remarks: Fully Renovated Corner Unit in a Prime SoNo Location! This stylish & modern 'Cool Crash Pad' has been completely refreshed & is situated in one of SoNo's hottest spots! The corner unit features a brand-new Tesla Universal EV charger in a gated, motorized garage with remote control. Inside, enjoy new carpeting, upgraded kitchen flooring, a NEST WiFi Smart thermostat, and enhanced LED lighting with smart dimmer & remote control. The living space has been elevated with a new fireplace & TV unit-including a 55" TV & a 60" electric LED fireplace. Additional updates include fresh paint throughout, newly installed electrical outlets, switches, & plates, plus motorized blinds with remote control (light-filtering shades in the living room and blackout shades in the bedroom). The modernized bathroom adds to the unit's sleek appeal, while a ceiling fan in the BR enhances comfort. Located in the heart of vibrant, historic SoNo, this home offers easy access to Washington St international restaurants, art galleries, Maritime Aquarium, boutique shopping, & the upscale SoNo Collection Mall. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the proximity to Oyster Shell Park, Calf Pasture Beach, and scenic walking, biking, and jogging trails. With 10' ceilings and oversized windows, this bright, airy unit is one of a kind. Your exclusive EV charger is directly connected to your unit's electric bill. Building amenities feature a fully equipped gym, storage locker, & bike room. Pet-friendly! Quick walk to Train.
